objective: Maximize complete valid four-turn sessions per euro against B8 without relaxing TTFA p99 <=200ms, zero M0 stalls, PCM16 <=1 LSB

observed.status: pilot economic signal only; strict commercial gate failed

hypotheses.mechanism: FIFO admission queue wait dominates high-load request-to-first-audio TTFA
hypotheses.prediction: After controlling for admitted work and hardware, high TTFA covaries with enqueue-to-admit time while admit-to-first-audio remains relatively stable
hypotheses.falsifier: TTFA remains >200ms at comparable rates even when enqueue-to-admit time is near zero

hypotheses.mechanism: Generation, CPU contention or measurement/playback contributes materially independent of queue wait
hypotheses.prediction: Admission-to-first-audio or M0 stalls rise with concurrency even for negligible queue waits
hypotheses.falsifier: These measures remain stable across matched high and low load while queue wait alone accounts for the TTFA increase

minimum_intervention.comparison: B8 original vs FIFO+expiry only; no EDF, batching, new algorithm or new architecture
controlled: same PCM16 reference and virtual M0 playback
same four-turn text, idle and deadlines
same offered arrival schedule and offered-session denominator
minimum_intervention.change_one_variable: Offered arrival intensity; pre-register low, intermediate and high load around the observed TTFA transition
minimum_intervention.economics: Measured useful complete sessions per elapsed paid runner time; report bootstrap uncertainty and distinguish pilot from sustained cost
minimum_intervention.stop: Stop on failed invariants or noncomparable arrival traces; do not claim victory from successful GitHub job alone

decision: Hypotheses OPEN. Do not attribute causality or certify SES/euro until discriminant is executed and strict gates pass.
